translations: that He punishes them while you (are) among them
the One Who punishes them while they seek forgiveness
puzzle.hint: The Prophet's presence is a mercy, and seeking forgiveness averts Allah's punishment
puzzle.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
